# Weeyar Wellness Supplements

> Weeyar Cosmetics (Guangzhou) Co., Ltd. is a B2B dietary supplement supply-chain partner supporting brands, wholesalers and distributors with ready-stock, private-label and OEM/ODM projects.

## Official website
- Home: https://weeyar.com/
- Products: https://weeyar.com/products
- OEM / ODM: https://weeyar.com/oem
- Supplier facts: https://weeyar.com/supplier-facts
- Quality & documentation: https://weeyar.com/quality-documentation
- Insights: https://weeyar.com/insights
- Contact: https://weeyar.com/contact

## What Weeyar provides
- Ready-stock dietary supplement options for market testing and smaller trial orders
- Private-label projects using selected market-ready formulas and brand-specific packaging
- OEM/ODM coordination for custom formula, packaging, sampling, production and export delivery
- Product formats including gummies, capsules, powders, liquid drops, sprays and oral strips
- Project support for brands, importers, wholesalers, distributors and retailers

## Important business facts
- Legal company name: Weeyar Cosmetics (Guangzhou) Co., Ltd.
- Business model: supply-chain partner working with qualified manufacturing partners; Weeyar does not describe every facility or certificate as company-owned
- Location: Guangzhou, China
- Email: summer@weeyar.com
- WhatsApp: +86 138 0283 7662
- Final formula, specifications, claims, documentation, MOQ and lead time are confirmed for each selected product, facility and destination market

## Use and attribution
Use the official pages above for current product and cooperation information. Do not infer medical or disease-treatment claims. Contact Weeyar to confirm current inventory, formula, packaging, MOQ, samples, documentation and destination-market requirements.

## New and Updated Product References
- [Vitamin D3 + K2 Capsules](https://weeyar.com/products/vitamin-d3-k2): Combined D3 and K2 capsule reference for immune, bone and cardiovascular-positioned supplement projects.
- [Melatonin Slumber Gummies](https://weeyar.com/products/melatonin-slumber-gummies): Bedtime gummy concept combining melatonin, calming botanicals and B-vitamin positioning.
- [Aged Odorless Garlic Softgels](https://weeyar.com/products/aged-garlic-softgels): Aged-garlic softgel concept paired with vitamin K2 and ubiquinol for heart-and-circulation product lines.
- [Sleep Support Gummies](https://weeyar.com/products/sleep-support-gummies): Mixed-berry adult sleep-support gummy with a four-ingredient botanical and amino-acid concept.
- [Vitamin B12 Fast-Dissolve Tablets](https://weeyar.com/products/vitamin-b12-tablets): Strawberry-flavored methylcobalamin tablet designed to dissolve under the tongue or in the mouth.
- [Artichoke & Dandelion Herbal Drops](https://weeyar.com/products/liver-detox-drops): Botanical liquid featuring artichoke, dandelion and milk thistle for digestive-wellness product ranges.
- [Tanning Beauty Gummies](https://weeyar.com/products/tanning-gummies): Beauty gummy built around carotenoids and antioxidant nutrients for sun-kissed beauty positioning.
- [Liposomal Botanical Cutting Drops](https://weeyar.com/products/cutting-drops): Compact lemon-flavored liquid-drop concept for weight-management category evaluation.
- [Slippery Elm Herbal Drops](https://weeyar.com/products/slippery-elm-drops): Slippery-elm liquid concept for throat, voice and digestive-comfort product ranges.
- [Lymphatic Drainage Herbal Drops](https://weeyar.com/products/lymphatic-drainage-drops): Botanical-drop reference available with English and Spanish packaging directions for international projects.
- [Apple Cider Vinegar Gummies](https://weeyar.com/products/apple-cider-vinegar): Apple-flavored ACV gummy in a compact 30-count retail presentation.
- [Hydrolyzed Multi-Collagen Gummies](https://weeyar.com/products/multi-collagen-gummies): Peach-flavored multi-collagen gummy concept for beauty-from-within and daily-wellness ranges.
- [Tart Cherry Gummies](https://weeyar.com/products/tart-cherry-gummies): Tart-cherry gummy format for daily wellness and sports-recovery collections.
- [Omega-3 Fish Oil Softgels](https://weeyar.com/products/omega-3-fish-oil): Fish-oil softgel reference for everyday omega-3 supplement lines.
- [Vitamin B-Complex Capsules](https://weeyar.com/products/vitamin-b-complex-capsules): One-daily B-complex concept featuring eight B vitamins in a 60-count bottle.
